authorization: Source research and documentation only. Application construction and live work require future authorization.

canonical_artifact_format.digest_limit: Local document binding; not a native multisig signature, compare-and-swap condition, or authorization.

adapter.runtime_api_gate: Published candidate V14/API2 observations do not supply input/output codecs. Provide exact target ReviveApi version binding through ApiOptions.runtimeApis, with real codecs or metadata-bound type IDs; Dedot built-ins contain no ReviveApi.

qualification_dependencies.reference_semantics: An operation's required_gate_refs identify mandatory qualification domains, not a declaration that those gates have passed. Resolve source, codec, capability and current-input requirements before signing; evaluate the operation's effects after finality. A setup operation must not require its own output in advance.
qualification_dependencies.postcondition_semantics: produces_evidence_for_gate_refs identifies evidence contributed by an operation; one observation does not automatically pass an entire aggregate gate or qualify the target.
qualification_dependencies.precondition_precedence: The explicit operation preconditions and inherited policies remain mandatory. Gate references do not replace them or permit an unknown input to be assumed.
qualification_dependencies.read_collection: Qualification and recovery evidence may be collected while gates remain blocked, but authoritative interpretation requires the relevant accepted decoder and identity context. Incomplete evidence cannot enable signing or mark success.
qualification_dependencies.multisig_inheritance: GRC-MULTISIG-FIRST and GRC-MULTISIG-FINAL inherit all required gates and fresh preconditions of their containing operation; generic multisig qualification cannot authorize an unqualified inner call.
qualification_dependencies.funding_scope: Funding operations require the donor's spendable balance, fee and liveness inputs before signing; the recipient's funded budget is their output. A mapping operation requires verified mapping semantics and sufficient backing before signing; its actual reverse-mapping equality is a finalized output.
qualification_dependencies.continuity_scope: Q-CONTINUITY is an outcome gate established after attributed M1 application continuation, not a prerequisite that can already be declared passed before that action.
qualification_dependencies.disabled_operation_rule: Gate evidence never enables an operation whose selected_status is disabled or whose enabled field is false.
qualification_dependencies.grant_scope: Q-GRANT-SCOPE: controlled round-zero authoring only. Scope breach permits exact original-depositor cancellation and, only after independent historical continuity proof, optional direct vest_other. External reclaim/proxied vest remain observable but non-authorable.

global_policies.applicability: Every operation inherits these policies unless it explicitly has a stricter rule.
identity: Normalize AccountId32 to raw bytes before sorting or comparing.
SS58 is display formatting, not an independent identity.
A B C D must be four distinct canonical native accounts.
Derive M0/M1 using exact native multisig encoding; reject equality.
Learn P from finalized PureCreated plus storage, never future inclusion prediction.
Compute h(P) with qualified mapper and independently verify reverse mapping.
Never request a direct wallet signature from P, M0, or M1.

native_encoding.field_order: Native argument order and types must be taken from accepted target metadata; no hardcoded pallet or call indexes.
native_encoding.dispatch_selector: Native pallet and call variant indexes come from accepted target metadata and are SCALE encoded; Solidity four-byte function selectors do not select native calls.

abi_encoding.canonical_signatures: Source-qualified Vestry ABI signatures describe the pinned contract source; Q-CONTRACT must bind the actual deployment, ABI and code before use.
abi_encoding.function_selector_rule: First four bytes of Keccak-256 of the UTF-8 canonical ABI function signature, derived only after accepting the exact ABI.
abi_encoding.source_selector_limit: A source-only selector is not evidence of deployed contract identity, target support or native Revive field order. No encoded selector or calldata is supplied by this catalogue.
abi_encoding.argument_order: Use exact accepted ABI tuple and argument order for contract calldata; use target native metadata separately for the enclosing Revive, Proxy and Multisig RuntimeCalls.
abi_encoding.metric_selector_argument: MilestoneInput.metricSelector is a bytes4 argument used by optional metric evaluation, not the selector of createGrant or submitMilestone; the selected metric-disabled profile uses symbolic ZERO_BYTES4.

preflight: One stable finalized read anchor; no mixing latest Ethereum reads with finalized native storage.
Complete operation-relevant state and authority observations; unknown is not absent.
Sufficient qualified spendable liquidity for each payer; locked face balance is not operational liquidity.
Origin-correct Revive estimate with exact versioned runtime API, if relevant.
Full nested call dispatch weight bound, not only Revive execution estimate.
Disposable clone for fee estimation; preview never invokes sign or legacy dryRun(account).
Fresh role/state/deadline/profile checks before final signer request and before broadcast.
Compare raw metadata and code identity independently of specVersion and SDK cache. All new grant submissions/reviewer approvals require Q-GRANT-SCOPE EligibleSingleRound.
signing: Before any wallet invocation, atomically commit LocalOperationProgress.reviewedSigningContext, exact originalSignPayloadJcsUtf8, request identity and additional-signed bytes. Commit failure means zero wallet calls (SG-30).
Human chooses actual native account and approves one explicit request.
Retain reviewed signPayload and additional-signed context; genesis/specVersion cannot all be inferred from extrinsic bytes alone.
Signature-only facade requests withSignedTransaction=false and rejects an alternate signedTransaction.
Decode returned native bytes to compare call, signer and encoded extras; separately verify captured additional-signed context.
Persist exact signed bytes and hash before a separate broadcast step.
No service secrets, automatic signing, one-shot hidden call mutation, or background resigning.
receipt: Native extrinsic is canonical; Ethereum transaction hash/receipt is neither assumed nor required.
Correlate exact extrinsic hash/bytes with finalized block and tx index.
Restrict native events to ApplyExtrinsic(txIndex) and expected closed call tree.
Check System, Multisig, Proxy and contract/Revive boundaries where present; outer success alone is insufficient.
ProxyExecuted has no standalone P/M identity; bind it through the decoded call tree and event sequence.
Use qualified native Revive contract-event decoding plus ABI events; qualify target event shape instead of inventing Ethereum logs.
Require operation-specific finalized state readback and a latest finalized drift check.
Execution events, resulting storage and state_call runtime need separate context identities.
Upgrade after broadcast cannot stop execution; unresolved same-block evidence stays unresolved until properly decoded, even if later stable reads work.
Preserve causal round-zero M1 submission before a later same-block release/change request; mismatched earlier round change invalidates intended business proof.
retry: Timeout or disconnect means submission_unknown until exact attempt, nonce, native proposal and postconditions are reconciled.
Rebroadcast only identical signed bytes while valid and after reconciliation; never silently choose a new nonce.
A new signature, changed inner limit/calldata, new Pure, new grant, or broader authority needs a fresh reviewed intent.
Local review expiry does not erase native multisig approvals.
First approval finalizes before the second signer is asked.
Reorged inclusion is provisional; only canonical finalized observations authorize the next stage.
ScopeBreached cannot be dismissed or reset by import; permit only separately eligible incident recovery operations.
global_policies.semantic_identity: SG-29 seals intentId + intentRevision to semanticIntentDigest independently of full immutable record digest. Observation refresh never changes semantic identity or silently retargets an attempt.
global_policies.post_proof_refresh: Only direct GRC-VESTING-VEST-OTHER is authorable, after independently verified historical continuity and the completed strict comparison interval; never a substitute for M1 grant use.

proposal_outcome_classes.FIRST_APPROVAL: Present with exact call hash, original depositor, first approval, native stored timepoint and reserved proposal deposit; no inner execution.
proposal_outcome_classes.PRE_DISPATCH_FAILURE: Wrong timepoint, invalid membership, duplicate approval or inadequate final max_weight can preserve the existing proposal; read storage and correlate events before deciding.
proposal_outcome_classes.DISPATCHED_SUCCESS: Threshold execution consumes proposal and releases original proposal deposit; business success still requires deeper results and postconditions.
proposal_outcome_classes.DISPATCHED_INNER_FAILURE: Threshold execution consumes proposal even when Proxy or wrapped call fails; repair cause then start fresh proposal/approvals/timepoint.
proposal_outcome_classes.UNRESOLVED: Do not infer consumption or preservation; reconcile finalized Multisigs storage and correlated native events.
